name: not-again
description: Self-hosted multi-currency double-entry bookkeeping, with receipts, tax categories and filing.

SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Rails session/cookie signing key. Leave the generated value.

ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY.description: Encrypts stored HMRC tokens. Leave the generated value — losing it makes those columns unreadable.

APP_HOST.description: The address this app answers on, no https:// — e.g. yourname.osc-fr1.scalingo.io, or your own domain once you point it here.

S3_BUCKET.description: Object-storage bucket for receipts (e.g. a Scaleway bucket).

SMTP_ADDRESS.description: Outgoing mail server — Scaleway Transactional Email.

SMTP_USERNAME.description: Your Scaleway project ID (not the organisation ID).

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: Secret key of a Scaleway IAM application with TransactionalEmailFullAccess.

SERVICE_NAME.description: What this installation calls itself — shown on the legal pages.

CONTACT_NAME.description: Person or company legally responsible — shown on the legal pages.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Public contact address for the legal pages and security.txt. Use a disposable alias, not your real mailbox.

CONTACT_TRADING.description: Trading name, if different from CONTACT_NAME.

CONTACT_CITY.description: Post code and city for the Impressum.

ASSET_HOST.description: Optional CDN hostname in front of the assets. Leave blank to have the app serve its own.

REPO_URL.description: The public repository this was deployed from; shown as a link on the landing page. Pre-filled for this repository — change it if you're deploying your own fork instead.

MAIL_FROM.description: The From: address on outgoing mail, on the domain verified in Scaleway, e.g. no-reply@yourdomain.com. Defaults to no-reply@<your APP_HOST>, which Scaleway refuses for a scalingo.io address.

scripts.postdeploy: bundle exec rails db:migrate && bundle exec rails tax_categories:load
